subject.title: CLI: openclaw message send hangs indefinitely after successful delivery

question: Should maintainers accept the active PR's guarded private `ws._socket` unref as the canonical fix for this successful-delivery CLI hang?
rationale: The bug is source-backed and the active PR is narrow, but the implementation depends on a private `ws` field and has mechanism-level proof rather than a full live Discord `message send --json` run.

options.title: Land the active teardown fix
options.body: Accept the guarded private-socket dependency in the gateway-client lifecycle path and close this issue after the PR merges.

options.title: Require full live CLI proof
options.body: Ask for a redacted live `openclaw message send --json` run showing complete output and natural process exit before merge.

options.title: Request a public lifecycle alternative
options.body: Pause the PR if gateway owners want to avoid private `ws` internals and design a different shutdown mechanism.

recommendation.title: Land the active teardown fix
recommendation.body: Accept the guarded private-socket dependency in the gateway-client lifecycle path and close this issue after the PR merges.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history signal for the adjacent lingering-socket lifecycle behavior is `steipete`'s gateway client force-stop work.
